title: Friday Quick Tip
subtitle: Wait a day to talk about the game
hook: A parent walks toward you right after the final whistle.
intro: A parent has a concern and wants to talk now.
statement: Hard conversations go better after a night's sleep.
q1: Do you ask parents to wait 24 hours to talk —
q2: or listen right away while it is fresh?
q3: When are you at your calmest after a game?
t1: There is no single right way. But conversations go better
t2: when everyone has had time to cool down.
cta: Coaches — when do you talk with parents?
ctaLines: Wait a day. Set a time. Keep it private.
Right away or the next day?
ctaPrompt: Share your parent habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
A parent walks toward you right after the final whistle.
A parent has a concern and wants to talk now.
Hard conversations go better after a night's sleep.
Talk right away or wait a day. Both can work.
When do you talk with parents? Share your habit in the comments.
